name: Rose Tyler
oracle_text:
Rose Tyler gets +1/+1 for each time counter on it.
Bad Wolf — Whenever Rose Tyler attacks, put a time counter on it for each suspended card you own and each other permanent you control with a time counter on it.
Doctor's companion (You can have two commanders if the other is the Doctor.)
blocked_sentences: Bad Wolf — Whenever Rose Tyler attacks, put a time counter on it for each suspended card you own and each other permanent you control with a time counter on it.

needs.what: a selector key (usable inside a value `count`) that matches a suspended card (702.62b: in exile, has suspend, has a time counter -- the engine's `suspended_by` mark on the object), so an amount can count 'each suspended card you own'; the rest of the amount is a `sum` with `{"count": {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "you", "has_counters": "time", "exclude_self": true}}`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: selector_keys has no suspended key; `zone: exile` + `owner: you` + `has_counters: "time"` only approximates 'suspended' and would also count a card exiled with time counters that is not suspended (e.g. a foretold or vanishing-leftover card). The first line is expressible as a self `buff` whose power/toughness are `counters_on` time on self_only, and the attack trigger itself is `attacks` with source self plus `add_counters`
